name: fabric-agent-adapter
description: Create new Fabric-compatible agents, build them as always-alive local services with dashboards (fabric-service/0.1), and adapt existing projects to the Fabric Agent Contract through evidence-backed MCP, A2A, or local-runner provider bundles; and teach a coding agent to work in a project through Fabric (fabric-mcp, fabric_whoami, claim and release), with Claude Code session hooks.
